mechanism.statement: the trial's captured row (row_before) was the previous trial's unlocked row in 11 of 90 trials: _unlock_and_capture waits for the state machine, then reads the newest unlocked row from the recorder, which commits once per second; phase 2 writes the member id into row_before, the judged row and every row of row_before's context, so these trials wrote their own (judged) row and the previous trial's row, each once
mechanism.consequence_for_PSR: the second write puts the same member id into a row that already holds it (the previous trial's phase-2 write ran first in the same loop): no content change, and the row is the previous trial's own touched row; detection and the floor are unaffected (both rows are touched under the counting rule)
mechanism.not_cross_trial_harness_state: no state crosses trials except the recorder itself: the captured row is simply the newest unlocked row at capture time
mechanism.display_check_uses_the_judged_row: the 90/90 admin display result (exp/out/e_psr_clo_display_check.json) is computed from each trial's rendered rows at its own `when`, so it is about the trial's own row

census_all_runs.rule: raced = the captured row (row_before) is the previous valid trial's row_before or judged row, same report file and arm

consequences_in_other_arms.PS, PSR, INS-M (swap): own row and the previous row both written with the swap value; PSR/INS-M write the same member id (a same-value rewrite); PS writes fresh random bytes, so the previous row's value changes
consequences_in_other_arms.PU, PI, INS-L (laundering, two phases): the context query matches no row and the event query no event (the previous trial already re-pointed its row and deleted its events), so the raced trial deletes 0 events, leaves its own author's call_service event in place, and re-points its own row and the previous row to its cover
consequences_in_other_arms.P reading: a raced P trial edits only the captured row, i.e. the previous trial's row, never its own; _find_genuine_automation_run() without a bound picks the most recent run, the same cover as the previous trial, so the UPDATE writes the values already there and the DELETE finds nothing: the trial changed nothing in the recorder, and its detection is the previous trial's segment scored again
consequences_in_other_arms.STALL/OUTAGE reading: the previous trial's row had already been laundered, so the captured context is the previous trial's COVER: the trial deleted that genuine automation run's events ([3] events) and re-pointed every state row carrying that context (4 to 11 rows) to a new cover
